Manifest.Description: 工作台直接读取所在地区的所有箱子，不再需要把箱子围在工作台周围；支持连在一起箱子、背包打造页附近箱子与范围选择；单机下自动跳过正在被使用的箱子（均可配置开关）。|The workbench now reads every chest in the area, no more surrounding chests; supports connected chests (including storage furniture like dressers), backpack-crafting nearby chests with selectable range; in single-player it skips chests currently in use (all configurable).
